stemMd: What is the main lesson drawn from exposing the drainage system?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Buried pipes always communicate their operation clearly

options.label: B
options.textMd: A dry channel always proves complete failure

options.label: C
options.textMd: Visibility can aid understanding but still needs explanation and maintenance

options.label: D
options.textMd: Visible infrastructure should never be built

explanationMd: The author recognizes the educational opportunity of a visible channel while showing its limits. Observers may misread what they see, and physical faults remain possible. Interpretation and inspection complement visibility.

distractorRationale.a: The comparison does not support this claim.
distractorRationale.d: The design’s interpretive value is acknowledged.
distractorRationale.e: Attention is not a substitute for maintenance.
